Owner cancellation/deadline fences remain authoritative; parent cancellation does not assert downstream undo or stop.
Separate parent database namespaces prevent chosen workflow/task-name collisions. Existing model transcript CAS remains covered.
preserved_boundaries: Existing 4B answerer unchanged; no 9B substitution, TypeSafe call or live provider probe.
Production Agent-C daemon/gateway inactive and disabled; dedicated PostgreSQL exited restart=no.
Only GitHub publication authorized; Panda excluded. Private .config/, local AGENTS.md/PANDA_PUSH.md and pre-existing docs/PUBLISHING.md remain outside the implementation commit.
limitations: This protects native remote submission correlation, not distributed exactly-once physical/business execution, multi-authority goal handoff or deleted destination history.
Preserve the original database namespace and admission history. Previously attempted tasks without admission records fail closed; no migration/adoption from old result text.
Bounded synchronous polling still occupies one worker until its attempt yields; general worker-free remote waiting is not claimed.
Future native reads consume current network/step grants. Reconciliation grants no additional budget and cannot revive owner stops.
Linux fixtures do not establish MCU, physical-device, live-provider, hosted CI or optional external PostgreSQL integration qualification.
Memory authority/eligibility/evidence refactoring and bounded multi-hop retrieval quality measurement are the next owner priorities, not implemented by this remote-call milestone.
